title: PMSV FSSAI Helper — third batch: cereal/bakery/soy products and fats/oils
basis: FSSAI-official chapter compendia; evidence routes, not compliance clearance
amendment_alerts: Fats and oils 2025 compendium contains highlighted 2026-02-01 effective amendment text for certain refractive-index ranges; check amended values and original Gazette.
FSSAI expressly states original Gazette amendments prevail in any discrepancy with compendium.
Dairy products (Chapter 2.1) not included in this batch: defer rather than assign incomplete references.
method_guardrails: Standards apply to identity of traded finished product, not automatically to composite food containing the ingredient.
All evidence positive-gate checks require product processing and formulation facts.
A variant route within one regulatory article does not necessarily represent a separate statutory category or a novel master-ledger SKU.
No numerical contaminant/additive/incident thresholds copied from raw ingredients to compound end foods.
All active amendment review required before a legal compliance result.
No changes to live WordPress product helper or original product ledger.
